checks.text: The page shows the heading "Signature Pad" and the button "Clear canvas" is visible.
Clicking the button "Clear canvas" removes any existing strokes; the canvas area is empty and the button "Save PNG" is disabled.
Drawing a stroke on the canvas (pressing and dragging the pointer) enables the button "Save PNG" and shows the text "Signature ready" below the canvas.
Selecting "Red" in the select labelled "Stroke color" and drawing a new stroke changes the stroke color to red; the select shows "Red" as the selected value.
Setting the slider labelled "Stroke width" to 10 and drawing a new stroke produces a thicker line; the slider value displays "10".
Clicking the button "Save PNG" downloads a file named "signature.png" and shows the toast message "Signature saved".
Clicking the button "Undo" after drawing two separate strokes removes the most recent stroke; the canvas shows only the first stroke.
Clicking the button "Redo" after an undo restores the removed stroke; the canvas shows both strokes again.

Reload keeps the drawn signature and the stroke color setting: after drawing a stroke with color "Blue" and reloading, the canvas still shows the stroke and the select labelled "Stroke color" shows "Blue".
